label: QRT 5
description: MikroTik QRT 5 (RB911G-5HPnD-QRT) — 1x 1G RJ45, Wi-Fi 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core AR9342.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (8-28 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 12 W.
